521692.deferralNote: The signing bonus is entirely deferred, paid in five equal installments from 2030-2034. $2.5M from each contract year is also deferred, for a total of $12M deferred. The contract will be fully paid out by 5/10/2034.

605141.deferralNote: $120M deferred ($5M of the signing bonus and $115M of salary), paid from 2033-2044.

605483.deferralNote: Specific injury required to trigger option is unknown. $55M is deferred, paid in 12 equal yearly installments from 2035-46.

606192.deferralNote: $32 million is deferred, paid in equal yearly installments from 2030-2039.

606466.deferralNote: $46M is deferred: $5M of 2025's salary, $6M from 2026, $3M from 2027, $10M from 2028, and $11M from 2029. The deferred money is paid the tenth year after it is earned, meaning Marte's contract will be fully paid out in 2040.

608070.deferralNote: $10 million is deferred annually, with each year of deferrals payable in ten equal yearly installments beginning the tenth year after the contract year.

621242.deferralNote: $4.5 million is deferred annually, with ten equal yearly installments beginning ten years after the contract year. The 2029 option may only be exercised if Díaz has a "specified injury" or "specified surgery" such that he isn't healthy to end 2028.

623993.deferralNote: Opt out may be voided by increasing 2028 salary to $17.25M and 2029 salary to $15.25M, plus exercising 2030 option at $17.5M. $6.75M of the signing bonus and $10M from each guaranteed year is deferred; the entirety of the 2030 buyout would be deferred. Total deferrals are up to $61.75M.

640455.deferralNote: $7.75M each year is deferred, paid in $2.325M installments from 2035-2044.

642207.deferralNote: $5M is deferred annually, paid in installments of various size from 2036-2045.

650911.deferralNote:
$10M each from 2031 and 2033 is deferred, each paid in five installments of $2M each. The 2031 deferrals are paid from 2035-2039, and the 2032 deferrals from 2040-2044.

Sánchez's prior 4 yr, $22.5M extension, covering 2025-28 (with club options for 2029-30), is partially overwritten by the new extension beginning in 2027. Under his old extension, Sánchez's AAV was $5.625M, and remains such for 2025-26, even though Sánchez will only earn $6.5M ($3.25M AAV) over the two years of his extension. Because the Phillies are overcharged by $4.75M when comparing to what Sánchez actually earns, that difference is credited to the life of his new contract, further lowering its AAV.

656302.deferralNote: $10M of the 2026 salary is deferred, followed by $9M from each of the last six seasons. The deferrals are paid out from 2033-2046.

656945.deferralNote: $5.25M of each guaranteed year's salary is deferred.

660271.deferralNote: $68 million deferred annually, to be paid 10 years after the contract year

663538.deferralNote: $10M is deferred, in the form of $2.5M deferred from each of the last four years. Hoerner will receive $1.25M each year from 2040-47.

663656.deferralNote: $30 million is deferred, $10M each from 2027-29. Tucker is paid in ten equal installments from 2036-2045.

664285.deferralNote: Signing bonus is deferred, paid in 10 equal installments of $2M from 2030-2039.

669242.deferralNote: $25M is deferred, paid in ten equal yearly installments from 2035-2044.
